tweet_summary: Comedian Lil Samsquanch jokes 'ESPN is charging an extra $15/monthly for sound on Redzone'.
why_note_decision: Tweet is a joke by an account self-described as 'Comedian'. Every top reply is a comedy riff in the same register ('upgraded from black & white last week', 'I'm paying $7.99 for closed captioning', 'still on the GIF-only version'). No sincere factual claim. Community correctly rated original note NOT_HELPFUL (dominant tag noteNotNeeded). Bot should decline.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note is a false positive. FAIL any note that: (a) literally explains ESPN's actual NFL RedZone pricing (the original note's failure), (b) calls the tweet misleading, or (c) misses that the author is a comedian and the replies are a joke chain.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Post falsely claims ESPN charges $15 extra "for sound on Redzone." ESPN actually charges $15/month for NFL Plus (includes full NFL RedZone with audio/video), not sound as separate add-on. https://thedesk.net/2025/08/espn-unlimited-nfl-redzone-plus-bundle/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: note_not_needed — fact-checks an obvious joke by a comedian. The reply chain is all riffs in the same comedic register.

fact_check.notes: Author bio: 'Comedian'. Replies are all jokes ('upgraded from B&W', 'paying $7.99 for closed captions'). The tweet itself is too absurd-on-its-face to be a sincere consumer-news claim.

importance.lens_rationale: 1.46M-impression joke. Primary value: bot must recognize comedian's jokes.
